items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Yes, I worked with him a number of times. Used to play, we used to play dances together too.

ctx.x: I worked with Bud. Because I worked with Bud quite a bit around here. Oh, with Jimmy Noon, was he with you then too? Yes, no, he was with, with me down here with Dave Payton had a band in Cabaret, Cafe de Paris. One place down in the old Royal Garden. Oh yes, I heard of that. And he was with us then. And then I think, who else was it? Some other band I worked with, Bud Scott. I can't think. I don't know whether it was Cook. No. I don't know whether it was Cook or not, but I think. Anyway, Bud was around in those…
See, Johnny Lindsey was the bass player on those Jelly Roll records. Yeah. Yes, yeah.

Did you ever work with him any place else? No, no. I owned a dance job several times. He played trombone too. Oh yes, that's right. Yes, uh-huh. Yes, I worked with him a number of times. Used to play, we used to play dances together too. Did you ever work with Roy Palmer on trombone? Roy Palmer? Yes. Uh, let's see, who wasn't a regular job? Where was it? I think that was on some dance work too.
